prompt: how to write a good unit test
response: To write a good unit test, start by identifying the specific functionality of the class or method you want to test. Then, create a test case that tests a single part of the class, such as a method that returns a specific value or performs a specific action. Use assertions to verify that the method behaves as expected under different conditions. Include test data to ensure the method works with various inputs. This approach helps in validating the class's behavior and helps catch errors early.
